shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 4 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

for p in i18n icons uikit; do node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; done; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui' -A3 package-lock.json | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>/dev/null; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup useLang 2>&1 | head -60

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1 | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -200; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/example

rg -n -i -C 4 "configure|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name "configuration*" -o -name "configure*" | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/utils/configure.d.ts $U/utils/configure.js; ls $U/i18n 2>/dev/null; cat $U/i18n/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; rg -n "lang|Lang" $U/components/theme/*.d.ts | head; cat $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; sed -n 80,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -40

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "theme" $U/index.d.ts; grep -n "filterable\|placeholder\|options?\|width?\|onUpdate\|label?" $U/Select/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "page\|total\|onUpdate\|compact\|showInput\|showPages" $U/Pagination/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "text\|size\|view" $U/ClipboardButton/ClipboardButton.d.ts | head; ls $U/*/i18n -d | head -40

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/ClipboardButton/ClipboardButton.d.ts | head -30; cat $U/Select/i18n/en.json $U/Pagination/i18n/ru.json $U/ClipboardButton/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null; ls $U/Select/i18n; cat tsconfig.json

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -n gravity package.json; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "ControlGroupProps\b" -A22 $U/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "hasClear" $U/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "interface ControlGroupOption" -A6 $U/types.d.ts; grep -n "SelectOption<" -A8 $U/Select/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,14p; grep -n "label?\|placeholder" $U/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts | head
grep -n "TODO: implement\|Implement the requested" src/main.tsx src/App.tsx
grep -n "as Translation" src/i18n/keysets/ru.ts; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6
